TEXT: Let me reveal one surprising fact here.
This summer, I got a girlfriend.
Her name is...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: This appearance... has to be new for you, isn't it?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
I may be inexperienced, but from here on, I will be 
placing myself in your care.
Makishima Saori.
It's pretty surprising.
Right now... I'm dating that "Saori."
Man... life is a strange thing.

When I first saw Saori, it was such a shock that I 
choked on a glass of water.
Looking back, that was really rude of me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Alright, let's do this.

Summer's almost over, so I'd like to spend some 
time with her, if possible.
With that in mind, it's time I grabbed my cell phone.

Just then, right as I was about to call, my phone 
rang... It was Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hello...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Um... Kyousuke-san. This is Saori.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey.
It's my first phone call from my girlfriend...
My voice stiffened.

Judging from her voice, she's got to be feeling 
nervous too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Well... um... I am actually nearby your house now.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
If you don't mind, I was hoping you could spare 
some time...
...Damn.
What impeccable timing.
Haha... This has to be fate.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Actually, I was just about to call you as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Is that so? ...Hehe, great minds think alike.

I unknowingly imagined that she's next to me, 
whispering right into my ear, that thought startled 
me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Um... um...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
It will be our first time seeing each other since... 
"that."

"That" probably refers to when Saori confessed to 
me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's right.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
... I would like to talk about... various, uh, topics 
regarding the future.
Stuff about the future... Huh.
No doubt about it.

I berated myself for not getting around to thinking 
about it, but when I thought about how this would 
be our first date, my heart started racing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Alright, come over to my place then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It just so happens that the really annoying one isn't 
here, so we can talk at our own pace.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Eh... n-no, that's a bit...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
To pay a visit to your house so suddenly... would 
require me to be very... prepared...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Prepared?
What's that all about?
She's been here plenty of times already.

...Although now that I think about it, Saori might be 
right. Things are different now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, I get it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Eh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It'd be pretty bad to call you over to my place for 
a first date. Especially when no one's home.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: P-Please don't say it so bluntly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hahaha, sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I am at the nearby park now... Can you come here?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sure, I'll head there right now.
